1.

directing the Respondents to initiate acquisition proceedings with regard to subject Patel Girishkumar Bhikhabhai vs State Of Gujarat on 8 July, 2025

situated at Village: Sabalpur, Taluka:
Vadnagar, District: Mehsana, forthwith as per New Act and to pay compensation with all consequential benefits and to pay interest as provided under Section 80 of the new Act from the date of taking over the possession of the subject land i.e.11.08.1988, in the interest of justice."
NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/3376/2025 ORDER DATED: 08/07/2025 undefined 2.

In a vague manner the petitioners would submit that the respondents have used the lands of the petitioners situated at village Village: Sabalpur, Taluka Vadnagar, District Mehsana for the purpose of construction of Sub- minor SM33L Canal of Vadnagar Distributory Minor M4L Canal without there being any acquisition and possession of the subject land has been taken on 11.08.1988.

The description about the ownership of the petitioners to the land in question is in a table extracted in Paragraph No.'3' of the writ petition without there being any supporting documents to ascertain that the petitioners were owners of the land in question at the time of taking possession in the year 1988.
3. Upon instructions, Ms. Hetal Patel, learned Assistant Government Pleader appearing for the State respondents would submit that there is an acquisition and award of the year 1989.
Moreover, the documents appended with the writ petition in Form No.7 are of the year 2019.

It is, thus, difficult for us to ascertain the correctness of the statement made by the petitioners that the possession of their lands, description of which has been given in Paragraph No.'3' of the writ petition, has been taken away in the year 1988 without any acquisition proceedings.

4. At this stage, Mr. A. V. Prajapati, learned advocate appearing for the petitioners would submit that the petitioners be permitted to withdraw the present petition with the liberty to bring the correct and NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/3376/2025 ORDER DATED: 08/07/2025 undefined complete facts pertaining to the land in question on the date of taking possession with relevant documentary material on record.
5. In view of the above, the writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with the liberty as prayed for.
